'''Reeayah''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-using [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force Adept]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Reeayah was born on the Twi'lek [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and did not wish to become a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] like many of her species, so she fell in with a group of dark side Twi'lek witches, who taught her the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. She later joined the [[Cularin Pirates]] and she immediately became obsessed with it's leader [[Dorel-Kan]] and they had a very close working relationship. During the [[Confederation Rock Rush]] in c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Reeayah used the dark side to track a ship to an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. She and the rest of the pirates landed their ship there and attacked the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who had been crewing the ship that they had been tracking.
